title: carex tenuissima var. duvaliana
intro: Carex tenuissima var. duvaliana, commonly known as Tufted Sedge, is a type of sedge plant belonging to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, where it is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and pain, due to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Carex tenuissima var. duvaliana include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, which helps to relieve muscle spasms, and as an expectorant, which aids in the removal of mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
